characters.summary: John Stockton was a cerebral point guard who controlled games through elite playmaking, precise passing, and disciplined perimeter defense. He punished defensive lapses with high-percentage shooting and flawless execution of the pick-and-roll.
weaknesses: Lacked elite vertical athleticism compared to premier wing scorers
mobility: Standard human speed with exceptional lateral quickness
limitations: Relies on structured offensive sets rather than isolation takeover scoring

characters.summary: Julius Erving was a pioneer of high-flying acrobatic offense, combining unmatched vertical leaping ability with fluid ball-handling and dominant transition scoring. He attacked defenses with explosive dunks and creative above-the-rim finishes.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to physical, heavy-contact half-court trapping in later career years
mobility: Exceptional vertical leap and explosive open-court speed
limitations: Reliant on spatial openness for transition and driving momentum

sources.supports: ABA and NBA MVP history, scoring records, and athletic profile.

notableResults.note: Won the championship sweep featuring iconic above-the-rim plays.

unknowns: Adaptation of high-flying style to modern heavy-volume three-point systems

characters.summary: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar utilized his towering frame and the unstoppable Skyhook to anchor elite offenses and defenses. He dominated the paint with supreme longevity, scoring touch, and prolific shot-blocking.

techniques: Post-up hook shots with either hand

weaknesses: Vulnerable to extremely physical, box-and-one type perimeter sagging if passing lanes were clogged
mobility: Fluid center mobility with exceptional height and reach
limitations: Requires entry passes into the low post to initiate primary scoring

sources.supports: All-time scoring records, MVP awards, and Skyhook efficacy.

notableResults.note: Won Finals MVP at age 38, defeating Boston.

unknowns: Defensive switches against modern five-out pace-and-space offenses

characters.summary: Karl Malone was a durable, physically imposing power forward who dominated the paint through sheer strength, relentless pick-and-rolls, and a lethal mid-range jumper. He overwhelmed defenders with high-volume scoring and rugged physical contact.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to quick, multi-directional face-up stretch fours
mobility: Exceptional power forward straight-line speed and strength
limitations: Dependent on elite point guard delivery (e.g., John Stockton) to maximize playmaking entry

sources.supports: Career scoring milestones, MVP awards, and physical durability profile.

notableResults.note: Lost the series in six games despite strong regular season dominance.

unknowns: Ability to carry a franchise without an elite pass-first point guard

weaknesses: Chronic knee tendinopathy limiting regular-season availability
mobility: Standard elite wing lateral quickness and footwork
limitations: Requires load management and cautious minute restrictions

characters.summary: Kevin Durant is an elite, uniquely tall scoring forward with a virtually unguardable perimeter jumper, exceptional ball-handling, and weak-side shot-blocking. He scores effortlessly from any spot on the floor regardless of defensive coverage.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to aggressive physical trapping and double-teams against ball-handling pressure
mobility: Fluid, guard-like agility packaged in a 6-foot-11 frame
limitations: Slender frame can be worn down by relentless physical body-checking in the low post

sources.supports: Scoring titles, MVP honors, and career shooting percentages.

notableResults.note: Hit a game-winning deep three-pointer in Game 3 on the way to winning Finals MVP.

unknowns: Performance under extreme sustained full-court defensive trapping without secondary playmakers

characters.summary: Kevin Garnett was an intensely vocal, versatile big man who combined elite interior defense, passing, mid-range shooting, and relentless emotional leadership. He defended every position on the floor and anchored championship defenses.
mobility: Exceptional lateral agility and speed for a big man
limitations: Offensive production scaled through team ball movement rather than high-volume isolation scoring

sources.supports: MVP award, Defensive Player of the Year, and championship history.

notableResults.note: Anchored the Boston Celtics defense to win the 2008 NBA Championship.
